mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_plan_case (id, plan_id, case_id, required, result, note, executed_by, executed_by_user_id, executed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{planId}, #{caseId}, COALESCE(#{required}, 0), #{result}, #{note}, #{executedBy}, #{executedByUserId}, #{executedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT case_id FROM test_plan_case WHERE plan_id = #{planId}

SELECT pc.id, pc.plan_id, pc.case_id, pc.result, pc.required, pc.note, pc.executed_by, pc.executed_at, c.title, c.case_no, c.module, c.priority, c.demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, c.latest_status, c.latest_bug_task_id FROM test_plan_case pc JOIN test_case c ON c.id = pc.case_id LEFT JOIN demand d ON d.id = c.demand_id WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY c.module, c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
SELECT * FROM test_plan_case WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_plan_case SET result = #{result}, note = #{note}, executed_by = #{by}, executed_by_user_id = #{byUserId}, executed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
UPDATE test_plan_case SET required = #{required} WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.select: SELECT pc.case_id, pc.result, pc.required, pc.executed_by, pc.executed_at, c.case_no, c.title, c.demand_id, d.title AS demand_title FROM test_plan_case pc JOIN test_case c ON c.id = pc.case_id LEFT JOIN demand d ON d.id = c.demand_id WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY c.case_no IS NULL, c.case_no, c.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_plan_case WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.name FROM test_plan_case pc JOIN test_plan p ON p.id = pc.plan_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pc.case_id = #{caseId} AND p.status <> 'done' ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id
